Subject: Post-call recap: price sensitivity & target $/1M vs OpenAI/Anthropic

Hi Emma / team — great to connect today. Quick recap from our discovery and proposed next steps: 

1) Volume profile (as discussed):
- Pilot (Q3): ~15M tokens / month
- Ramp target (Q4 run-rate): 180M tokens / month
- Peak bursts: up to 300M tokens in marketing/event windows

2) Target unit economics you shared:
- Procurement target: $700–900 per 1M tokens for generation workload (chat + few-shot prompts)
- Sensitive to latency: P95 target 250ms on user-facing calls

3) Competitive benchmarks we reviewed on call (rough):
- OpenAI: ~$2,000 / 1M tokens (varies by model + context)
- Anthropic: ~$1,400 / 1M tokens (Claude endpoint approximations)
- Hosters using open models (quantized/FP16): can be as low as $300–600 / 1M with batching/caching

4) Redwood angle / initial proposal:
- With a Dedicated pool + aggressive batching and prefix caching we can show a path to ~$650 / 1M at your steady-state profile.
- For pilot we recommend a trial at $1,200 / 1M with a committed 3-month ramp (protects margin while we tune).

5) Ask / next steps:
- Emma: confirm the 180M monthly run-rate target and whether the budget band ($700–900 / 1M) is "hard" or "stretch".
- Monica/Karthik: please review attached pricing deck + sample MOP workbook and confirm if we can present the pilot commercial (3mo commit, trial pricing) by Thu EOD.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-deck-v3.pdf (pricing slides), avery-proposed-mop.xlsx (workload profile template)

Thanks — Aditya

--

Thanks Aditya — helpful summary. Couple clarifications: 

- Volume: 180M/month is our target in Q4 if pilot traction is good. Pilot baseline will be 15M/mo as you noted.
- Budget: our procurement ceiling is $900 / 1M tokens. $700 / 1M is where our finance team feels comfortable long-term. Anything above $900 needs exec sign-off. 
- Latency: 250ms P95 is important for the triage flow only; async background inference can tolerate higher latency.

We can do the pilot with a 3-month commit, but we need a clear rollback clause and a credit if SLAs are missed more than 2x in a month. Can you send draft terms (simple) and confirm whether the $650 / 1M projection is net of all infra discounts or a target after optimization?
